nodes.label: Delegate tasks
nodes.description: Runs up to six independent tasks as bounded agent turns.

nodes.label: Plan steps
nodes.description: One bounded model call that proposes 1-8 independent steps.

nodes.label: Research agent
nodes.description: Runs a bounded agent turn and returns a structured finding.

nodes.label: Load dataset
nodes.description: Reads a dataset by reference. A missing or expired reference is an explicit failure.

nodes.label: Save dataset
nodes.description: Stores a JSON payload in the local dataset store and returns a small reference.

nodes.label: Parse JSON
nodes.description: Parses a JSON string into a structured object.

nodes.label: Set variables
nodes.description: Builds a named variables object from configuration and an optional input object.

nodes.label: Constant / input
nodes.description: Emits a literal value, or the value arriving on its input.

nodes.label: Write file
nodes.description: Writes a payload inside a named, operator-configured scope.

nodes.label: Historical prices
nodes.description: Reads gateway-backed OHLCV with provider provenance; feeds the indicator nodes.

nodes.label: Indicator
nodes.description: Computes a deterministic technical indicator.

nodes.label: Market data
nodes.description: Reads a price series via the existing data gateway + JDDS.

nodes.label: Live quote
nodes.description: Reads a live quote through the existing market gateway, with provenance.

nodes.label: For each
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow once per array item, up to a hard cap.

nodes.label: Gate
nodes.description: Runs only when its control input fires — the if/else branch primitive.

nodes.label: Repeat
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow N times, passing the previous output on.

nodes.label: Subworkflow
nodes.description: Runs a pinned saved workflow as a nested run with the same grants.

nodes.label: While
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow while a safe numeric condition holds.

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Calls an external HTTP endpoint. Egress is default-deny.

nodes.label: Aggregate / group
nodes.description: Numeric aggregate, optionally grouped by dotted fields.

nodes.label: If / else
nodes.description: Routes control flow on a declared comparison.

nodes.label: Deduplicate
nodes.description: Keeps the first row per key, or per whole row when keys is empty.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Keeps numeric items whose formula result is non-zero.

nodes.label: Map
nodes.description: Evaluates a formula for each numeric item (vars: value, index).

nodes.label: Merge
nodes.description: Joins two branches back into one value.

nodes.label: Reduce
nodes.description: Accumulates numeric items (vars: acc, value, index).

nodes.label: Stop
nodes.description: Ends the run here; downstream nodes are skipped.

nodes.label: Switch
nodes.description: Fires `matched` or `default` and reports the case index.

nodes.label: Wait
nodes.description: Pauses for a bounded time; a durable run defers the job instead of blocking.

nodes.label: Result
nodes.description: Terminal node — captures the workflow result.

nodes.label: Backtest
nodes.description: Runs a deterministic backtest through the existing quant engine.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo
nodes.description: Stress-tests a strategy through the existing Monte Carlo engine.

nodes.label: Out-of-sample evaluation
nodes.description: Splits the series chronologically and compares in-sample with out-of-sample.

nodes.label: Optimize parameters
nodes.description: Searches a parameter grid through the existing quant optimizer.

nodes.label: Returns
nodes.description: Simple or log returns of a series over a period.

nodes.label: Volatility
nodes.description: Rolling standard deviation of log returns, optionally annualized.

nodes.label: Walk-forward
nodes.description: Rolling train/test validation with out-of-sample metrics.

nodes.label: Z-score
nodes.description: Rolling standard score of a series.

nodes.label: Citations & claims
nodes.description: Reads citations and claims for a research run.

nodes.label: Verify claim
nodes.description: Verifies one claim against stored evidence with the existing verifier.

nodes.label: Completeness check
nodes.description: Summarizes coverage, supported claims, citations and unresolved conflicts.

nodes.label: Conflicts
nodes.description: Reads stored source conflicts for a research run.

nodes.label: Retrieve evidence
nodes.description: Reads stored evidence for a research run, with an optional text filter.

nodes.label: Research report
nodes.description: Builds a deterministic Markdown report from the stored research graph.

nodes.label: Crawl site
nodes.description: Crawls a bounded set of same-site pages from one start URL.

nodes.label: Fetch page
nodes.description: Fetches one page through the SSRF-hardened web bridge and returns its text.

nodes.label: Web search
nodes.description: Searches the web through the configured provider chain.

nodes.label: Broker account
nodes.description: Reads the broker account and positions for a connection.

nodes.label: Broker bars
nodes.description: The broker's own OHLCV series for symbols JDDS cannot proxy.

nodes.label: Cancel order
nodes.description: Cancels one working order. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Close position
nodes.description: Closes one position (full/partial) or all positions. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Modify position
nodes.description: Moves SL/TP on one position. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Broker order
nodes.description: Submit one order to a broker connection under a bounded, revocable mandate.

nodes.label: Broker quote
nodes.description: Bid/ask/spread from the broker, including symbols JDDS may not carry.

nodes.label: Paper order
nodes.description: PAPER-only execution adapter: simulates a fill at the supplied price.

nodes.label: Risk check
nodes.description: Pure pre-trade gate: reduces or rejects an order against the risk limits.

nodes.label: Formula
nodes.description: Evaluates a bounded arithmetic expression over numeric inputs.

nodes.label: Join rows
nodes.description: Inner, left, right, full or anti join of two arrays of objects on dotted keys.

nodes.label: Select fields
nodes.description: Selects and renames columns in an array of objects.

nodes.label: Sort / limit
nodes.description: Sorts rows by dotted keys (or the whole row) and optionally limits them.

nodes.label: Template
nodes.description: Renders a string template from its inputs.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Starts a run when a user executes the workflow by hand.

nodes.label: Schedule
nodes.description: Starts a run on a timezone-aware cron schedule.

nodes.label: Video render
nodes.description: Builds a data-bound market-recap storyboard and queues the native video render.
